Name: Under The Umbrella - An Umbrella Mod for Stardew Valley
Author: DanJD97
Description:
[size=4][b]It's raining! Get under your damn Umbrella!! ☔[/b][/size]

Inspired by the loved [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8366]Remember Your Umbrella Mod[/url] - Under the Umbrella adds functionial and visual umbrellas to Stardew Valley!
So when it's raining, you don't need to get soaked!

[b]Umbrellas can be purchased at Pierre's General Store![/b]

[center][b][size=5]Features[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]10+ Umbrellas[/*]
[*]Holding an umbrella in rain gives you a speed boost [/*]
[*]Optional 'wetness' mechanic - Walk in rain without an umbrella, you'll get slowed. Have an umbrella and you'll be fast![/*]
[*]Option to allow Hats can offer protection (has to be configured via GMCM)[/*]
[*]Full multiplayer support! Check out each others Umbrella's! Who has the best one? 👀[/*]
[/list][center][b][size=5]Required Mods[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]SDV 1.6+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list][center][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[left]As this is a new mod I am not sure of the full compatibility, however I built this around my modded playthrough which had A LOT of mods. Either way it should be compatible with most mods![/left]
[left][/left]
[left]So far, everything works on Android too! 💪

Let me know if you find any issues![/left]
[/center]

[center][b][size=5]Shout outs[/size][/b][/center]
[color=#d4d4d8]Big thanks to OceanSmith who made the amazing '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8366]Remember Your Umbrella[/url]' Mod!! I loved this mod on my original modded playthrough and I missed it so much I went to make my own. Ocean you are truly an inspiration! ❤️[/color]

Manifest.Name: Under the Umbrella
Manifest.Description: Adds fully visual umbrellas to Stardew Valley — complete with canopy overlay, speed boost in rain, and a rainbow Magic Umbrella.
Manifest.Author: DanJD97
